name: Evangelical
likelyAffirmations: Scripture should directly shape belief and practice
faith should become personal trust and public witness
discipleship includes repentance, service, and mission
discernmentQuestions: Does this call for trust in Christ and obedience to Scripture?
What fruit of discipleship is visible?
How does this serve witness and love of neighbor?
pastoralWarnings: Do not reduce faith to private experience.
Do not use urgency to flatten careful discernment.
